services.name: Boat Rentals
services.desc: Here at HHM we offer the finest Pontoon Rentals on Lake Allatoona. Our fleet is less than 2 years old and is made up of Starcraft and Tahoe Luxury Pontoons, one of the best built Pontoon Boat Lines in the Market. These are boats you would be proud to own not stripped down rental models. Boat Rentals Include all Necessary Equipment. Tube Rentals Include Tow Line and Ski Vests. All Cancellations require 72-hour notice or you will be charged full rental price. We do allow cancellations for inclimate weather or hazardous conditions on the day of rental.
